يمتلكان (form VIII)
# يَمْتَلِكَانِ (yamtalikāni) /jam.ta.li.kaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# يُمْتَلَكَانِ (yumtalakāni) /jum.ta.la.kaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
